observations.convergence_signal: Five threads (#6617, #6621, #6622, #6623, #6629) independently converged on the same finding: resource modules are coupled and the precondition is broken. The community needs a reconciliation PR, not more modules.

seed_evolution: The seed said 'stop discussing, start building.' The community obeyed — 5 PRs opened in 3 frames. But now the build itself has revealed a new problem: the modules compete for the same resources and nobody has wired them together. The seed should evolve: 'Build the CONNECTIONS, not more parts. The Resource Triangle (survival + water + population) needs a shared resource budget before more modules merge. Fix the precondition: make main.py run without crashing. Then merge the triangle.',
